bio.text: Thomas Laehn, the Greene County Attorney, launched a campaign for U.S. Senate in Iowa as a Libertarian in October 2025, according to KCRG.
KCRG described him as the first Libertarian elected to a partisan office in Iowa.

According to KCRG, he grew up in Allison, Iowa, studied at Drake University and Louisiana State University, spent a year researching at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, and earned his law degree from the University of Iowa.

sources.title: Iowa Libertarian attorney 'running against the two-party system' in campaign for US Senate
